boat.full_description: Strong build.  Epoxy  bonded Lapstrake  plywood. Reinforced seats and gunnels for extra  rigidity. All spars, rudder, daggerbord included. Sail needs some TLC. Easy to row with adult and child.
boat.name: Duckling
boat.short_description:
Ideal boat for child to learn the basics of sailing while also doubling up as small two person tender  
Beamy and stable with high freeboard  
Impress the watching aesthetes  and old salts on the quay!
